# Temple Scroll Column 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 22 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**22:1** Make a copper basin on a copper stand for washing, and place it between the tent of meeting and the altar.

**22:2** Fill it with water. Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and feet in it.

**22:3** Whenever they enter the tent of meeting, they must wash with water — or they will die. The same applies when they approach the altar to serve, to present a fire-offering to Me.

**22:4** They must wash their hands and feet, or they will die. This is a permanent requirement for him and his descendants in every generation.

**22:5** Construct the courtyard around the tabernacle. Along the south side make linen curtains of finely spun thread, one hundred cubits long for that entire side.

**22:6** Set twenty pillars in twenty copper bases along this side, with silver hooks and silver crossbars on the pillars.

**22:7** The north side shall match: curtains one hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars in twenty copper bases, and silver hooks and crossbars.

**22:8** Across the west end of the courtyard, hang curtains fifty cubits wide on ten pillars with ten bases.

**22:9** The east end of the courtyard, facing the sunrise, shall also span fifty cubits.

**22:10** On one side of the entrance, hang curtains fifteen cubits long on three pillars with three bases.

**22:11** On the other side of the entrance, hang matching curtains of fifteen cubits on three pillars with three bases.

**22:12** For the courtyard gate itself, make a woven screen twenty cubits wide from blue, purple, and scarlet yarn with fine linen — the work of a skilled weaver — hung on four pillars with four bases.

**22:13** Band every pillar around the courtyard with silver; fit them with silver hooks and set them in copper bases.

**22:14** The courtyard dimensions: one hundred cubits long by fifty cubits wide on each side, five cubits high, with curtains of fine linen and copper bases.

**22:15** Every tool used in the tabernacle's service, along with every tent-peg and courtyard stake, shall be made of copper.

**22:16** All these things are holy to Me. No one shall defile them, for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 22 well preserved. "Hangings" modernized to "curtains" and "linen curtains" for accessibility. "Shoulder" (katef) rendered as "side of the entrance" to clarify the architectural layout. The death warning is made direct and emphatic.*
